name: Xoroth: Drag Through Hell summons a party member on another map (#11884, #12278)
contract: Drag Through Hell 804773 says it summons a party member from anywhere in the world. Its only effect is
SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PLAYER, whose target is the caster's selection, found globally by
Spell::SelectEffectTypeImplicitTargets. AddUnitTarget then runs Spell::CheckEffectTarget, whose default case
requires IsWithinLOSInMap, and that is false for any player on another map (or out of sight on the same one).
The effect mask was emptied, so the cast completed and spent its cost but no summon was offered (#11884,
#12278). Ritual of Summoning 7720, the stock spell with the same effect, carries SPELL_ATTR2_IGNORE_LINE_OF_SIGHT.
A grouped knight in Elwynn selects an ally in Orgrimmar and casts 804773 with no explicit target: the ally

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Let the ally finish the far teleport
Carry the Infernal Stone 804773's Totem[0] requires
Select the ally: the summon effect resolves the caster's selection
SETUP: no summon is pending yet
CONTRACT: the ally on another map was offered the summon
